newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank says expects no legal action by NY Fed.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank says expects no legal action by NY Fed.

text.p: Asahi Bank Ltd believes the Federal Reserve Bank of New York will not take legal action against Asahi's New York branch for looking at a confidential Fed inspection report this summer, a senior bank official told a news conference on Friday.
A senior official at Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Thursday that Asahi officials told the MOF that they opened a U.S. Federal Reserve report that was reported to be confidential.
Asahi president Shigehiko Yoshino said in an interview with Kyodo news service on Thursday that the bank's New York branch could face legal action for looking at the report.
However, the Asahi official said on Friday: "I don't think the Fed will ever take legal action against us."
"There exist no irregularities involving money at the New York branch," he added.
